stored_text.note: official.html is the CAC page with the transmittal notice 国信办通字〔2025〕2号 (four issuers, dated 2025年3月7日, posted 2025年03月14日) and the full Chinese text of all 14 articles. The gov.cn copy was not stored (robots.txt unreachable).

english_version.note: One web search found no English version from the CAC or another public body. Unofficial English versions use varying titles ('Measures for Labeling of AI-Generated Synthetic Content', 'Measures for the Identification of AI-Generated Synthetic Content'). None is stored.

title.source_quote: 人工智能生成合成内容标识办法
title.why: Literally 'AI generated-and-synthesised content labelling measures'. 标识 can be 'label' or 'identification'; 'Labeling' fits Art. 3, which describes visible and embedded marks. Accurate.

summary_claims.claim: Requires explicit (user-visible) labels and implicit labels (file metadata, with digital watermarks encouraged) on AI-generated text, audio, images, video and virtual scenes.
summary_claims.original_quote: 服务提供者提供的生成合成服务属于《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》第十七条第一款情形的，应当按照下列要求对生成合成内容添加显式标识：
summary_claims.literal_translation: Where the generation and synthesis services provided by a service provider fall within the circumstances of Article 17, paragraph 1, of the Provisions on the Administration of Deep Synthesis Internet Information Services, it shall add explicit labels to the generated or synthesised content according to the following requirements:
summary_claims.note: Explicit labels are tied to the Deep Synthesis Provisions Art. 17(1) list, which ends with a catch-all for any service that generates or significantly alters content, so the summary's unqualified wording is a slight simplification. Art. 5 requires implicit labels in file metadata (在生成合成内容的文件元数据中添加隐式标识) and encourages digital watermarks (鼓励服务提供者在生成合成内容中添加数字水印等形式的隐式标识). The definitions in Art. 3 match 'user-visible' and 'implicit'.

summary_claims.claim: Content platforms must check metadata and add prominent notices to generated content ...
summary_claims.original_quote: 核验文件元数据中是否含有隐式标识，文件元数据明确标明为生成合成内容的，采取适当方式在发布内容周边添加显著的提示标识，明确提醒公众该内容属于生成合成内容；
summary_claims.literal_translation: verify whether the file metadata contains an implicit label; where the file metadata clearly marks the content as generated or synthesised, add a prominent notice label around the published content by appropriate means, clearly reminding the public that the content is generated or synthesised;
summary_claims.note: Items (2) and (3) extend the duty to content that users declare as generated, or that the platform detects as suspected generated content.

summary_claims.claim: ... and maliciously removing, altering, forging or hiding labels is prohibited.
summary_claims.original_quote: 任何组织和个人不得恶意删除、篡改、伪造、隐匿本办法规定的生成合成内容标识，不得为他人实施上述恶意行为提供工具或者服务，不得通过不正当标识手段损害他人合法权益。
summary_claims.literal_translation: No organisation or individual may maliciously delete, tamper with, forge or conceal the labels for generated or synthesised content provided for in these Measures, provide tools or services for others to commit such malicious acts, or harm the lawful rights and interests of others through improper labelling.

key_terms.original: 显式标识 / 隐式标识
key_terms.note: Literal; matches the Art. 3 definitions (明显感知 'clearly perceptible' versus 不易被用户明显感知 'not easily perceived by users').

key_terms.original: 没有添加显式标识的生成合成内容 / 不含显式标识的生成合成内容
key_terms.note: Art. 9 lets providers supply content without explicit labels, not unlabelled content: the implicit metadata label required by Art. 5 still applies. 'Unlabelled' changes the legal meaning.

key_terms.original: 互联网应用程序分发平台
key_terms.note: Literally 'internet application distribution platforms'; 'app stores' is a fair everyday rendering. Art. 7 requires them to ask whether an app offers AI generation services and to verify its labelling materials.

issues: Notes say 'Requests for unlabelled output are allowed only under user agreements'. Art. 9 allows only output without explicit labels (没有添加显式标识 / 不含显式标识); implicit metadata labels (Art. 5) remain required. Suggested: 'Users may obtain content without explicit labels only under a user agreement setting out their labelling duties, and providers keep logs for at least six months (Art. 9).'
Minor: the summary states the explicit-label duty without its link to Deep Synthesis Provisions Art. 17(1) (Art. 4). The practical effect is small because that list ends with a catch-all.
note: '14 articles' is correct (第十四条 is the last, effective 2025年9月1日). The notes say the Measures were published 'together with the mandatory national standard GB 45438-2025'; the stored notice does not mention GB 45438-2025 by number (Art. 11 refers to mandatory national standards in general), so this rests on the CAC Q&A cited in verification.note, which is not stored.
